title: Audit ingestion: delta archiver, tenant-aware storage governor, and RBAC-linked trails
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Design and implement a scalable audit ingestion pipeline variant that reduces storage costs while preserving full-fidelity trails for high-risk events. Deliverables: (1) a delta-archiver component that compacts low-value repetitive events into compact deltas while retaining replayability, (2) a tenant-aware storage governor that enforces per-tenant retention/partitioning policies with dynamic throttles and budget caps, and (3) linkage of RBAC v2 and SSO/SAML identity metadata into the audit trail to make admin actions queryable and attributable.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline accepts existing protobuf audit events and outputs two tiers: hot indexable event stream + compact delta archives for cold storage
Per-tenant retention policy enforced: <30d hot index, 30-365d cold compact archive (configurable)
Cost governor triggers when projected monthly egress/storage > tenant budget: applies sampling or delayed cold-tiering and emits alerts
RBAC v2 and SSO metadata join present on all admin-action events and surface in Console audit view
End-to-end test harness validates event replay from delta archives restores original sequence for a 30d window
Docs updated and rollout plan with canary on dedicated and hosted environments
notes: 2026-02-15 - Kickoff: scoped solution after PM workshop. Primary constraint: preserve legal/compliance fidelity for admin actions (RBAC/SSO ties).
2026-02-20 - Decision: use Kafka topic-keying by tenant_id + action_id to keep ordering of admin actions; secondary non-admin telemetry can be sharded more freely.
2026-02-27 - Prototype: delta-archiver running as consumer that applies windowed de-duplication and delta-emission; uses event fingerprints and sequence markers to enable deterministic replay.

2026-03-03 - Trade-off: aggressive sampling reduces storage but complicates post-hoc audits. Chosen approach: sampling only for low-risk events (health pings, rate metrics) with explicit allowlist of event types that must remain full-fidelity.

2026-03-06 - Security review: confirmed SSO/SAML identity assertions are included via a normalized identity envelope. Must not store raw SAML assertions; we store normalized subject_id and provider_id only. (Security req)

2026-03-08 - Implementation detail: cold archives written as columnar Parquet blobs grouped by tenant+month with an index file (compact manifest) to locate deltas for replay. Hot index stays in an optimized timeseries store for fast queries.

2026-03-09 - Cost governor spec: budget window evaluates projected spend using tokenized per-event cost model; governor actions include sampling rate adjustments, delayed writes to cold-path, and tenant notifications via webhook/Console.

2026-03-10 - QA plan: build synthetic tenant load tests (50k events/sec peak) with mixed admin/non-admin distribution; verify no admin event dropped and replay restores sequences for 7-day window in canary cluster.
